mapper.sql: id, public_no, chain, mode, status, trigger_type, active_chain, scheme_ver, token, destination, executor, created_by, reason, retry_of, address_count, expected_usdt, swept_usdt, fee_paid, fee_asset, params_json, tx_hash, block_number, fail_reason, created_at, sent_at, finished_at, expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.address, a.address_key, a.salt, a.scheme_ver, a.deployed_at IS NOT NULL AS deployed, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_deposit d WHERE d.chain = #{chain} AND d.to_address = a.address_key AND d.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_deposit, (SELECT MAX(d.block_number) FROM wallet_deposit d WHERE d.chain = #{chain} AND d.to_address = a.address_key AND d.status = 'CREDITED') AS last_credited_block, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_sweep_item i WHERE i.active_key = CONCAT(#{chain}, ':', a.address_key)) AS in_batch FROM wallet_address a WHERE a.family = 'ETH' AND a.scheme = 'FORWARDER' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallet_deposit d WHERE d.chain = #{chain} AND d.to_address = a.address_key) ORDER BY a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_sweep_batch (public_no, chain, mode, status, trigger_type, active_chain, scheme_ver, token, destination, executor, created_by, reason, retry_of, address_count, expected_usdt, fee_asset, params_json, created_at) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{chain}, #{mode}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{activeChain}, #{schemeVer}, #{token}, #{destination}, #{executor}, #{createdBy}, #{reason}, #{retryOf}, #{addressCount}, #{expectedUsdt}, #{feeAsset}, #{paramsJson}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO wallet_sweep_item (batch_id, item_no, address_id, user_id, address, salt, deploy, balance_before, est_fee, status, active_key) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{itemNo}, #{addressId}, #{userId}, #{address}, #{salt}, #{deploy}, #{balance}, #{estFee}, 'PENDING', #{activeKey})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_sweep_batch WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM wallet_sweep_batch WHERE status = #{status} AND mode = 'CONTRACT' ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM wallet_sweep_batch WHERE chain = #{chain} AND finished_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(finished_at) FROM wallet_sweep_batch WHERE chain = #{chain} AND status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'PARTIAL')
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_sweep_batch SET status = 'SENT', tx_hash = #{txHash}, sent_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE wallet_sweep_batch SET status = #{status}, swept_usdt = #{swept}, fee_paid = #{fee}, tx_hash = COALESCE(#{txHash}, tx_hash), block_number = #{blockNumber}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, finished_at = #{at}, active_chain = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT')
mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_id, item_no, address_id, user_id, address, salt, deploy, balance_before, est_fee, swept, status, fail_reason, tx_hash FROM wallet_sweep_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY item_no
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_sweep_item SET status = #{status}, swept = #{swept}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, tx_hash = #{txHash}, active_key = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE wallet_sweep_item SET active_key = NULL WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_sweep_tx (batch_id, chain, attempt, nonce, tx_hash, raw_tx, gas_limit, max_fee, priority_fee, status, created_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{chain}, #{attempt}, #{nonce}, #{txHash}, #{raw}, #{gasLimit}, #{maxFee}, #{priorityFee}, 'SENT', #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_id, chain, attempt, nonce, tx_hash, raw_tx, gas_limit, max_fee, priority_fee, status, created_at FROM wallet_sweep_tx WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY attempt DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_sweep_tx SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT batch_id FROM wallet_sweep_tx WHERE chain = #{chain} AND tx_hash = #{txHash} LIMIT 1
SELECT next_nonce FROM wallet_sweep_nonce WHERE chain = #{chain} AND operator = #{operator} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_sweep_nonce (chain, operator, next_nonce) VALUES (#{chain}, #{operator}, #{nonce}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_nonce = VALUES(next_nonce)
INSERT INTO wallet_sweep_event (batch_id, actor, text, created_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{actor}, #{text}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT created_at, actor, text FROM wallet_sweep_event WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_sweep_outflow (chain, tx_hash, log_index, block_number, from_address, to_address, amount, address_id, user_id, kind, batch_id) VALUES (#{chain}, #{txHash}, #{logIndex}, #{blockNumber}, #{from}, #{to}, #{amount}, #{addressId}, #{userId}, #{kind}, #{batchId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallet_sweep_outflow o WHERE o.kind <> 'SWEEP' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wallet_recon_issue r WHERE r.ref_id = CONCAT(o.chain, ':', o.tx_hash, ':', o.log_index) AND r.kind IN ('SWEEP_UNKNOWN_OUTFLOW', 'SWEEP_DEST_MISMATCH') AND r.status = 'RESOLVED')
